description: Create a complete BSH extension package skeleton at an absolute path: manifest 2.0, tool descriptors, command(s), prompt, scoped context, panel, skill, configuration schema and a dependency-free test that passes. Pass domain and brief for a domain package: it also writes docs/design.md, declares only the tools whose files exist and leaves the planned tools in an implementation checklist. Use this instead of writing a manifest by hand.

path.description: Absolute directory to create or fill.

id.description: Reverse-domain extension id, for example com.example.toolkit.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the id's last segment or the domain blueprint's name.

runtime.description: declarative ships pure tool bodies; process ships server.py. Omit in domain mode to use the blueprint's recommendation.

domain.description: Domain profile key (knowledge, devops, data, web, documents, media, messaging, security, research, model, system, generic) or a sentence that names the domain.

brief.description: One or two sentences the blueprint records for this package.

description.description: One paragraph for the manifest; defaults to the brief or the profile summary.

author.description: Author string for the manifest and LICENSE.

license.description: SPDX license id; defaults to MIT.
